title: Architecture
body:
# Architecture

`effect` supplies the runtime and shared services. Platform, SQL, AI and Atom packages build on those contracts. Workspace dependencies keep source changes visible across packages.

The SQL client owns transaction composition; drivers own connection and command-result behavior. See [Package layout](wiki:package-layout).
author: maya

proposals.summary: Document PostgreSQL aborted COMMIT handling and shared-driver cleanup.
proposals.diff: + Drivers inspect COMMIT outcomes; failed SQLite commits require rollback before connection reuse.

title: Release process
body:
# Release process

The 31 public packages share one Changesets fixed group. Pending entries live directly in `.changeset/`; `.changeset/pre/` is historical. The current prerelease tag is `rc`.

Preview using pinned Changesets tooling, review the complete group, then prepare a version PR. A person merges it. The Release workflow publishes and then dispatches website publication. A dispatch receipt does not prove deployment.
author: cora

title: Package layout
body:
# Package layout

Core: `packages/effect`. Integrations: `packages/ai`, `packages/atom`, `packages/platform`, `packages/sql`. Build and documentation tools: `packages/tools`. `packages/opentelemetry` and `packages/vitest` are standalone.

There are 38 packages: 31 public and seven private. Package ownership is proposed Smithers configuration, separate from access permissions. See [Contributing](wiki:contributing).
author: maya

title: Contributing
body:
# Contributing

Open an issue with the affected package, runtime and reproduction. cora or maya accepts the issue and makes a TODO. Changes include a focused regression and run the applicable runtime projects.

Shared configuration expands validation. An agent opens a PR; a person reviews and merges it. Runtime exclusions remain visible in the matrix.
author: cora
